note: Ps66 testimony (corrected; corporate praise -> individual witness). Human IB: the earth's shout for JOY + SING + PRAISE + WORSHIP + sing-praises + BLESS + high-praise; enemies COME-CRINGING before God's power; the summons SEE (v5) + HEAR (v16) + TELL what God did for my soul; REJOICE at the Red Sea; the REBELLIOUS not EXALTing; the preserved SOUL through the refining; the individual CRIED + PERFORM vows; the integrity of not CHERISHing iniquity (so God heard); closing BLESSED + prayer accepted. God-qualifiers=19 (glory/name x2/awesome x2/power/might/turned/rules/keep-watch/kept/tested/tried/brought-out/listened x2/attended/rejected/chesed). Cultic offerings + affliction imagery (net/burden/fire-water) = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: shout for joy (rua - shout for joy to God, all the earth)
issues in singing his glory and praise
'SHOUT FOR JOY (rua) to God, all the earth' — the universal summons to jubilant praise; rua here the exultant cry the whole earth is called to raise to God, the opening burst of a psalm of testimony
sing / make music (zamar - sing the glory of his name)

'SING (zamar) the glory of his name; give to him glorious praise!' — praise directed at the glory of God's name; zamar here the sung worship celebrating God's glory (the qualifier) - music offered to the name above every name
praise (tehillah - give to him glorious praise)

'give to him GLORIOUS PRAISE (tehillah)' — praise rendered as a glorious offering; tehillah here the praise made weighty and splendid, fitting the God of awesome deeds - worship as the giving of glory
cringe / feign submission (kachash - your enemies come cringing)
before the greatness of God's power

'So great is your power that your enemies COME CRINGING (kachash) to you' — the feigned, forced submission of the foes; kachash here the cowering pretence of obedience wrung from enemies by God's great power (the qualifier) - a submission of dread, not love
worship / bow down (shachah - all the earth worships you)
paired with singing praises to his name

'All the earth WORSHIPS (shachah) you and sings praises to you' — universal homage before God's awesome deeds (the qualifier); shachah here the bowing of all creation to God - worship as the whole earth's fitting posture
sing praises (zamar - and sings praises to you)
paired with worship, repeated to his name
'and sings PRAISES (zamar) to you' — the sung worship joined to bowing; zamar here the music of all the earth, praise that answers the awesome God
sing praises (zamar - they sing praises to your name)
the praise directed to God's name
'they sing praises to your NAME' — praise focused on the name of God; zamar here the earth's song to God's name (the qualifier) - worship named and directed, not vague
see / behold (raah - Come and see what God has done)
paralleled by the summons to come and hear (v16)
for God is awesome in his deeds (v5)

'Come and SEE (raah) what God has done' — the summons to witness God's works; raah here the invitation to behold the awesome deeds of God (the qualifier) - the corporate counterpart to 'come and hear' (v16), calling all to look on his acts
rejoice / be glad (samach - there did we rejoice in him)
who turned the sea to dry land and rules by his might (v6-7)

'He turned the sea into dry land... There did we REJOICE (samach) in him' — the joy of the delivered at the Red Sea; samach here the exultation of a people brought through the waters, rejoicing in the God who turned the sea and rules forever (v6-7, the qualifiers) - remembered deliverance made present praise
rebellious / stubborn (sarar - let not the rebellious exalt themselves)
watched by God's eyes on the nations (v7)

'let not the REBELLIOUS (sarar) exalt themselves' — the defiant whom God's watching eyes restrain; sarar here the stubborn rebels, warned not to lift themselves up against the God who rules the nations and keeps watch (v7, the qualifier)
exalt / lift up oneself (rum - exalt themselves)

'let not the rebellious EXALT (rum) themselves' — the pride that lifts itself against God; rum here the self-exalting of the rebels, forbidden before the God whose eyes are on the nations - arrogance God will not permit
bless (barak - Bless our God, O peoples)
making the sound of his praise heard
paired with making his praise resound

'BLESS (barak) our God, O peoples' — the corporate call to bless God who kept their soul alive; barak here the blessing all peoples are summoned to give the God who preserved them through testing (v9-12) - gratitude voiced as blessing
praise (tehillah - the sound of his praise)
the praise the peoples are to make resound
'let the sound of his PRAISE (tehillah) be heard' — praise made public and audible; tehillah here the praise the peoples cause to resound - worship not private but proclaimed abroad
be heard / make heard (shama - let the sound of his praise be heard)

'let the sound of his praise be HEARD (shama)' — the making-audible of God's praise; shama here the peoples causing his praise to be heard abroad - the public voicing of blessing, praise carried to all ears
soul / life (nefesh - who has kept our soul among the living)
among the living, through fire and water
whom God kept, tested, and brought out to abundance (v9-12)

'who has kept our SOUL (nefesh) among the living and has not let our feet slip' — the life God preserved through the refining; nefesh here the people's life, kept, tested as silver, and brought through fire and water to abundance (v9-12, the qualifiers) - the soul sustained by God across the ordeal
perform / pay (shalam - I will perform my vows to you)
with burnt offerings, in God's house

'I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will PERFORM (shalam) my vows to you' - the individual paying the vows made in distress; shalam here the discharge of what the lips uttered in trouble (v14) - the psalm turning from 'we' to 'I', gratitude made concrete in fulfilled vows
hear (shama - Come and hear, all you who fear God)
what God has done for the psalmist's soul
paired with the God-fearers summoned; parallels come-and-see (v5)

'Come and HEAR (shama), all you who fear God, and I will tell what he has done for my soul' - the summons to hear personal testimony; shama here the invitation to the God-fearing to listen to what God did for one soul - private mercy made public witness, the 'come and see' (v5) now 'come and hear'
fear / revere (yare - all you who fear God)
the audience summoned to hear the testimony

'all you who FEAR (yare) God' - the reverent community, the fit audience for testimony; yare here those whose fear of God makes them able to receive and rejoice in what God has done for a fellow believer's soul
tell / recount (saphar - I will tell what he has done for my soul)
what God has done for his soul
the testimony the God-fearers are called to hear

'and I will TELL (saphar) what he has done for my soul' - the recounting of personal deliverance; saphar here the declaring of God's work in one's own life - the individual testimony that is the psalm's turning-point, private grace told for the strengthening of all
cry / call (qara - I cried to him with my mouth)
paired with high praise on the tongue

'I CRIED (qara) to him with my mouth' - the prayer that God answered; qara here the crying to God that, joined with praise on the tongue, was heard (v19) - the testimony's substance: I cried, and God listened
high praise / extolling (romam - high praise was on my tongue)
paired with the crying to God

'and HIGH PRAISE (romam) was on my tongue' - extolling mingled with the cry for help; romam here the lifting-up of God even in the prayer of need - petition and praise together on the tongue, faith that praises while it asks
regard / cherish (raah - if I had cherished iniquity in my heart)
the sin that, if harboured, would block God's listening

'If I had CHERISHED (raah) iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened' - the integrity of an unharboured conscience; raah here (to regard with favour) the cherishing of sin the psalmist did NOT do - the clear heart being the condition of answered prayer, sin secretly loved would have shut God's ear (the qualifier)
prayer (tefillah - the voice of my prayer)
the prayer God has listened to and attended (v19)
which God has listened to and attended (v19)

'But truly God has listened; he has attended to the voice of my PRAYER (tefillah)' - the answered prayer that is the testimony's climax; tefillah here the prayer God listened to and attended (the qualifiers) - proof that God did not reject him, the ground of the closing blessing
for not rejecting his prayer nor removing his love
because God has not removed his steadfast love (v20)

'BLESSED (barak) be God, because he has not rejected my prayer or removed his steadfast love from me!' - the doxology sealing the testimony; barak here the individual's blessing of God, grounded in answered prayer and unremoved chesed (the qualifier) - the psalm ending as it began, in blessing
prayer (tefillah - he has not rejected my prayer)
the prayer whose acceptance grounds the blessing

'because he has not rejected my PRAYER (tefillah)' - the prayer God received; tefillah here the accepted prayer (God did not turn it away, the qualifier) - the assurance that seals the whole testimony, answered prayer proving God's steadfast love
glory (kavod - sing the glory of his name)
God's glory, the theme of the earth's song (v2)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's glory): 'sing the GLORY (kavod) of his name' - God's glory is not a human IB char; the subject of the earth's singing (281315). Qualifier.
name (shem - the glory of his name)
God's name, whose glory is sung (v2)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'the glory of his NAME (shem)' - God's name is not a human IB char; the name whose glory the earth sings (281315). Qualifier.
awesome / to be feared (nora - how awesome are your deeds)
God's awesome deeds, before which the earth worships (v3->v4)

v3 QUALIFIER (God's awesomeness): 'How AWESOME (nora) are your deeds!' - God's fearfulness is not a human IB char; the awesome quality of his deeds that draws all the earth's worship (281344). Qualifier.
power / strength (oz - so great is your power)
God's great power makes the enemies cringe (v3)
v3 QUALIFIER (God's power): 'So great is your POWER (oz)' - God's power is not a human IB char; the might that makes even his enemies come cringing (281341). Qualifier.
name (shem - they sing praises to your name)
God's name, the object of the earth's praise (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'they sing praises to your NAME (shem)' - God's name is not a human IB char; the object toward which the earth's praise is directed (281346). Qualifier.
awesome / to be feared (nora - awesome in his deeds)
God is awesome in his deeds, which all are summoned to see (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's awesomeness): 'he is AWESOME (nora) in his deeds toward the children of man' - God's fearfulness is not a human IB char; the quality of the deeds all are called to come and see (281350). Qualifier.
turn / change (haphak - turned the sea into dry land)
God turned the sea to dry land, in which the people rejoiced (v6)
v6 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'He TURNED (haphak) the sea into dry land' - God's parting of the sea is not a human IB char; the deliverance in which the people rejoiced (281364). Qualifier.
rule / have dominion (mashal - who rules by his might forever)
God rules forever by his might, in whom the people rejoice (v7->v6)
v7 QUALIFIER (God's rule): 'who RULES (mashal) by his might forever' - God's dominion is not a human IB char; the everlasting rule in which the delivered people rejoice (281364). Qualifier.
God's might, by which he rules, ground of the rejoicing (v7)
v7 QUALIFIER (God's might): 'by his MIGHT (gevurah)' - God's power is not a human IB char; the strength by which he rules forever, ground of the people's joy (281364). Qualifier.
keep watch (tsaphah - his eyes keep watch on the nations)
God's eyes watch the nations, restraining the rebellious (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'whose eyes KEEP WATCH (tsaphah) on the nations' - God's watching is not a human IB char; the vigilant gaze that warns the rebellious not to exalt themselves (281373). Qualifier.
set / keep (sim - who has kept our soul among the living)
God kept the people's soul alive (v9)
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'who has KEPT (sim) our soul among the living' - God's preserving is not a human IB char; the keeping of the people's life (281384) through the ordeal. Qualifier.
test / examine (bachan - you have tested us)
God tested the people, refining the soul he kept (v10->v9)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you, O God, have TESTED (bachan) us; you have tried us as silver is tried' - God's testing is not a human IB char; the refining of the people's life (281384) - discipline that purifies, not destroys. Qualifier.
refine / try (tsaraph - you have tried us)
God refined the people as silver, testing the soul he kept (v10->v9)
v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you have TRIED (tsaraph) us as silver is tried' - God's refining is not a human IB char; the smelting-discipline that purified the people's life (281384). Qualifier.
bring out (yatsa - you have brought us out to abundance)
God brought the people through fire and water out to abundance (v12->v9)

v12 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'we went through fire and through water; yet you have BROUGHT US OUT (yatsa) to a place of abundance' - God's deliverance is not a human IB char; the bringing-through that saved the people's life (281384) into plenty. Qualifier.
hear / listen (shama - the Lord would not have listened)
God would not listen had the psalmist cherished iniquity (v18)

v18 QUALIFIER (God's act, conditional): 'If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have LISTENED (shama)' - God's listening is not a human IB char; the answer that cherished sin (281302) would have forfeited. Qualifier.
hear / listen (shama - but truly God has listened)
God has listened to the psalmist's prayer (v19)
v19 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'But truly God has LISTENED (shama)' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; the answer that met the psalmist's prayer (281314), proof of his integrity. Qualifier.
attend / heed (qashab - he has attended to the voice of my prayer)
God attended to the voice of the psalmist's prayer (v19)
v19 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'he has ATTENDED (qashab) to the voice of my prayer' - God's heeding is not a human IB char; the attention he gave the psalmist's prayer (281314). Qualifier.
turn away / reject (sur - he has not rejected my prayer)
God has not rejected the psalmist's prayer (v20)

v20 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'he has not REJECTED (sur) my prayer' - God's turning-away is not a human IB char; the acceptance (not rejection) of the psalmist's prayer (281327) that grounds the blessing. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - or removed his steadfast love from me)
God has not removed his steadfast love, ground of the blessing (v20)

v20 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'or removed his STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) from me' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the love that remains, grounding the psalmist's closing blessing (281321). Qualifier.
give / set (sim - give to him glorious praise)
v2: 'GIVE (sim) to him glorious praise' - the verb of rendering praise; the praise itself is the char (281320). Standalone (the giving).
v2: 'give to him GLORIOUS (kavod) praise' - the splendour that qualifies the praise; carried in the praise char (281320). Standalone (the quality).
deeds / works (maaseh - how awesome are your deeds)
v3: 'how awesome are your DEEDS (maaseh)' - God's works; the object of the awe (the qualifier awesome, 281335). Standalone (God's deeds).
greatness / abundance (rob - so great is your power)
v3: 'so GREAT (rob) is your power' - the greatness that qualifies God's power (the qualifier, 281338). Standalone (the quality).
deeds / doings (alilah - awesome in his deeds)
v5: 'awesome in his DEEDS (alilah) toward the children of man' - God's doings; the object of the awe. Standalone (God's deeds).
dry land (yabbashah - turned the sea into dry land)
v6: 'He turned the sea into DRY LAND (yabbashah)' - the miracle of the parted sea; the object of God's turning (the qualifier, 281357). Standalone (the miracle).
pass through (abar - they passed through the river on foot)
v6: 'they PASSED THROUGH (abar) the river on foot' - the people's crossing (the Jordan/Red Sea); the historical deliverance, the rejoicing its char (281364). Standalone (the crossing).
forever / eternity (olam - rules by his might forever)
v7: 'who rules by his might FOREVER (olam)' - the everlasting duration of God's rule; a temporal extent of the qualifier (rules, 281366). Standalone (temporal).
sound / voice (qol - let the sound of his praise be heard)
v8: 'let the SOUND (qol) of his praise be heard' - the audible voice of praise; the praise it carries is the char (281381). Standalone (the sound).
slip / be moved (mot - has not let our feet slip)
v9: 'and has not let our feet SLIP (mot)' - the falling God prevented; the stability of the preserved soul (281384), the slipping that did not happen. Standalone (negated slipping).
refine / try (tsaraph - as silver is tried)
v10: 'you have tried us as silver is TRIED (tsaraph)' - the silver-refining simile for God's testing (the qualifier, 306482); the image of purifying by fire. Standalone (simile).
net / snare (matsod - you brought us into the net)
v11: 'You brought us into the NET (matsod)' - the trap of affliction God allowed; the image of the ordeal the people endured. Standalone (image of affliction).
lay / place (sim - you laid a crushing burden)
v11: 'you LAID (sim) a crushing burden on our backs' - the imposing of affliction; the burden is the object, part of the ordeal-imagery. Standalone (the laying).
crushing burden / affliction (muaqah - a crushing burden on our backs)
v11: 'a CRUSHING BURDEN (muaqah) on our backs' - the oppression the people bore in the testing; an experience of affliction (part of the refining), not a disposition. Standalone (the affliction).
v11: 'a crushing burden on our BACKS (mothen)' - the loins where the burden was laid; part of the affliction-imagery. Standalone (image).
ride / drive (rakab - you let men ride over our heads)
v12: 'you let men RIDE (rakab) over our heads' - the humiliation of being trampled by enemies; part of the ordeal the people endured. Standalone (the humiliation).
abundance / saturation (revayah - a place of abundance)
v12: 'you have brought us out to a place of ABUNDANCE (revayah)' - the plenty God brought the people into; the outcome of the deliverance (the qualifier, 306492). Standalone (the outcome).
burnt offerings (olah - I will come with burnt offerings)
v13: 'I will come into your house with BURNT OFFERINGS (olah)' - the sacrifices the psalmist brings; the cultic form of the vow-performing (the char, 306497). Standalone (cultic).
vows (neder - I will perform my vows)
v13: 'I will perform my VOWS (neder) to you' - the vows the psalmist pays; the performing is the char (306497). Standalone (the vows).
open / utter (patsah - that which my lips uttered)
v14: 'that which my lips UTTERED (patsah) and my mouth promised when I was in trouble' - the vowing in distress; the vows uttered, performed in the char (306497). Standalone (the uttering of vows).
offer / bring up (alah - I will offer burnt offerings)
v15: 'I will OFFER (alah) to you burnt offerings of fattened animals' - the sacrificial offering; the cultic act of the vow-fulfilment (the char, 306497). Standalone (cultic act).
burnt offerings (olah - burnt offerings of fattened animals)
v15: 'BURNT OFFERINGS (olah) of fattened animals' - the sacrifices offered; the cultic content of the vow-payment. Standalone (cultic).
fatlings (meach - burnt offerings of fattened animals)
v15: 'burnt offerings of FATTENED ANIMALS (meach)' - the choice fatlings offered; the costly cultic gift. Standalone (cultic).
smoke / incense of sacrifice (qetoreth - the smoke of the sacrifice of rams)
v15: 'with the smoke of the SACRIFICE (qetoreth) of rams' - the burning offering rising as smoke; the cultic form of worship. Standalone (cultic).
goats (attud - I will make an offering of bulls and goats)
v15: 'I will make an offering of bulls and GOATS (attud)' - the animals offered; the cultic content of the vow-payment. Standalone (cultic).
soul / life (nefesh - what he has done for my soul)

v16: 'I will tell what he has done for my SOUL (nefesh)' - the psalmist's self, the beneficiary of God's work; the telling is the char (281288), here the soul benefited. Standalone (the beneficiary-self).
iniquity / wickedness (aven - if I had cherished iniquity)
v18: 'If I had cherished INIQUITY (aven) in my heart' - the sin the psalmist did not harbour; the object of the (denied) cherishing (the char, 281302). Standalone (the sin not cherished).
v18: 'if I had cherished iniquity in my HEART (leb)' - the heart as the seat where sin would have been harboured; the cherishing is the char (281302, seat=heart). Standalone (the seat).
voice (qol - the voice of my prayer)
v19: 'he has attended to the VOICE (qol) of my prayer' - the sound of the prayer God heeded; the prayer it carries is the char (281314). Standalone (the voice).
